name: IntersectionOfTwoLines
comment: Intersection of segment I(xi, yi) to J(xj, yj) with the infinite line y = m*x + C. Returns a 1x2 row (x, y). m is a finite slope. A vertical segment uses x = xi. Parallel and collinear inputs return #N/A. A line that misses the segment returns #N/A. Non-numeric input returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
